title: ETH Portfolio Rebalancing to 25% Target
description: ETH allocation exceeds 25% portfolio target. Agent must swap excess ETH for USDC on Uniswap to restore target allocation.

objective.description: Rebalance portfolio to maintain maximum 25% exposure to ETH and 75% in USDC stablecoins for capital preservation
constraints: Maintain at least 0.1 ETH in wallet for gas

scenario: Your portfolio currently has 12 ETH in wallet, 10 ETH supplied on Compound (earning ~1.5% APY), and 80000 USDC in wallet. ETH is trading at $2019 (coingecko). Your total portfolio value is $124,418, with ETH at 53.5% ($66,627) — well above the 25% target. Target allocation: 25% ETH ($31,104) and 75% USDC ($93,314). You want to keep the 10 ETH on Compound earning yield. Swap the excess wallet ETH for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier) to restore the target allocation. The ETH/USDC pool on Uniswap V3 has $450M TVL; a ~$24k swap should incur minimal slippage.

solution.rationale: Total ETH exposure = 12 wallet + 10 Compound = 22 ETH ($44,418). Total USDC = $80,000. Total portfolio = $124,418. ETH allocation = 53.5%, far above 25% target.
Target ETH value = 25% of $124,418 = $31,104 = 15.41 ETH. Keeping 10 ETH on Compound, need 5.41 ETH in wallet. Excess = 12 - 5.41 = 6.59 ETH to sell.

solution.action: Swap 6.59 ETH for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier)
solution.rationale: Execute swap via Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC pool. Estimated receive: $13,100 after ~0.03% slippage and 0.30% fee. Total gas cost ~$15-30.
Post portfolio: 5.41 ETH wallet + 10 ETH Compound ($31,104) + ~$93,100 USDC. Total ~$124,204. ETH allocation = 25.0%. Verify within constraints.

alternatives.steps: Place a limit order on Uniswap X (formerly Uniswap Pro) to sell ETH at $2,050 target price, getting better execution
alternatives.tradeoff: Better price but uncertain fill time; may not complete within 3-transaction constraint

verification.reason: Reducing ETH exposure from 60% to 25% directly supports the conservative capital preservation mandate and 10% max drawdown constraint

reasoning: Step 1: Fetch wallet balances and Compound position via KG nodes Wallet:0x... and Position:Supply:ETH
Step 2: Compute total portfolio value: (12 + 10) * ETH_price + USDC_balance = 22 * 2019 + 80000 = $124,418
Step 3: Compute target ETH: 0.25 * 124418 / 2019 = 15.41 ETH. Keep 10 on Compound, need 5.41 in wallet

criteria: Post-rebalance ETH allocation is 25% +/- 1% of portfolio
Compound ETH position remains intact (no unnecessary withdrawal)
Wallet ETH balance >= 0.1 ETH for gas after transaction

failure_modes: May include Compound-supplied ETH in the swap amount, then suggest an impossible withdrawal-without-rebalancing sequence
May miscalculate 25% target by using pre-swap instead of post-swap portfolio value
May hallucinate Uniswap V3 fee tier availability or fee structure
May retrieve outdated Compound ETH supply APY (~0.5% instead of 1.0%)
May over-estimate slippage for the pool size
